notes.title: Small update
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

It's ebi here! I'm writing a quick post to let you know that I've uploaded a shiny new build of my old and crusty yuri VN (feat. Romantic poets!!!), [i]Asphyxia[/i]!

This shiny new update fixes several typos in the script of [i]Asphyxia[/i] which were found by people in my discord sever and on the Steam community page of [i]Asphyxia[/i]. This might be an older project, but it still feels nice to dust off the cobwebs and get it all cleaned up!
I also swapped out a few of the old, janky sound effects with newer, higher quality SFX, and I edited Lillian's pyjama sprites, since a few of them had a strange dark tint on her hair that the others didn't.

That should be about it. As always, if you encounter more typos or any bugs with the new build, please let me know. I'll try to fix them in a timely manner!

- ebi x

notes.title: Asphyxia revamp
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I'm writing this post to inform you that [i]Asphyxia[/i] has received a bit of a revamp! I've recently rewritten a significant chunk of text in the game, to correct some clunkier sentences that didn't 'flow' very well, and I've made several tweaks to the UI.

These changes are rather extensive, and were made in the newest version of Ren'py. As such, older saves of [i]Asphyxia[/i] will no longer be compatible with this update, and trying to load them will cause the game to crash. If you want to read through the story again, it would be best to start a brand new game. I'm sorry for the inconvenience!

Please note that, while much of the text has been edited/rewritten, I've not deleted any scenes, or added any new ones: the content of the story remains the same as it always was.

If you find any typos/grammatical errors in the script, or any technical issues, please let me know. It would be appreciated!

- ebi x

notes.title: New build
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I realise it's been about 2 years since I updated this last...

Here's a list of changes in this build:

* Redid the menus to make them look crisper
* Swapped out some of the old sound effects for newer, nicer ones
* Swapped out one of the backgrounds with a new, improved background
* Gave the player an option to choose between 2 font styles
* Darkened the textboxes
* Added an alternate, black textbox to make reading easier
* Added the Steam trading card images to the CG gallery, so they can be viewed whenever you want

And I changed the resolution from 1280x720 to 1920x1080!

As all the art assets in this VN were originally drawn at a far larger size than 1280x720, it was relatively easy to make a higher resolution version of this VN. The sprites and backgrounds should (hopefully) look crisper, and the text is bigger, which should make reading easier.

I was considering updating a few of my older VNs to 1920x1080 resolution. If people like this change, I can... consider it some more.

Are there any of my older VNs people would like to see at a higher resolution? If so, please let me know! >_<
(The Way We All Go and This World Unknown are not possible, however, due to the size of the original art assets.)

If you get any strange bugs or spot any typos etc, I'd appreciate it if you left some feedback!

Note: There was an issue causing this build to crash because I forgot to package a certain font with it. The new build I just uploaded should work fine. I'm sorry if this caused any problems >_<

- ebi x

notes.title: Empty Horizons released
notes.content:
Hi guys,

My newest VN, Empty Horizons, has just been released on Steam! It has the same writer/artist combination as Asphyxia does, so if you like the writing and artwork of Asphyxia, you might fancy taking a look. The writing style of EH is very different to Asphyxia's, though - it's not nearly as flowery, and everybody speaks in a much more naturalistic way.

The VN also has Steam achievements and trading cards~

http://store.steampowered.com/app/496630/

- Ebi x

notes.title: The Sad Story of Emmeline Burns
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

I have some exciting news. My free yuri VN, The Sad Story of Emmeline Burns, which was made for the Yuri Game Jam, is now up on Steam Greenlight. The story is relatively short, and will be completely free! The art was done by the same artist who worked on Asphyxia, and the writing style (in some scenes) is relatively similar. There are also a few references to Asphyxia in it, as well.

If you're interested in seeing this game on Steam, please vote for it [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=563115430]here![/url]

And, if you want to read the visual novel for yourself, it can be downloaded, in its entirety, on itch.io [url=http://ebihime.itch.io/emmeline]here.[/url]

The Steam version of the VN should be a bit more updated, with more spelling error fixes, corrections to any poorly constructed sentences, and there will be a new scene (with some new art) in it as well.

Thank you!

- Ebi
